n = int(input())
dice = list(map(int, input().split()))
pos = [0, 0]
score = [0, 0]
name = "AB"
for i in range(len(dice)):
    p = i % 2
    np = pos[p] + dice[i]
    if np >= n:
        score[p] += 1
    pos[p] = np % n
    if pos[p] == pos[1 - p] and score[1 - p] > 0:
        score[1 - p] -= 1
        score[p] += 1
    print(name[p], pos[p], score[p])
if score[0] > score[1]:
    print("A 승")
elif score[0] < score[1]:
    print("B 승")
else:
    print("무승부")
